title: Learned addressing under predictable-key and structured-channel controls
question: Can a learned address scorer provide value beyond trivial exact-key matching, while remaining calibrated to the Bayes-optimal raw-dot baseline?
relation_to_prior: Supersedes learned-address v1 as the intended next test; v1 is retained as instrument-invalid and is not remeasured.

design.exact_key_condition: diagnostic only; raw dot and learned scorer are expected to saturate and this condition carries no capability claim.
design.isotropic_gaussian_condition: query = unit target key + sigma*epsilon with epsilon isotropic Gaussian. Raw dot is the registered Bayes reference.
design.structured_channel_condition: query = normalize(D*k + sigma*epsilon), where D=diag([2]*8+[0.5]*8) is fixed across training/evaluation and unknown to the raw-dot baseline. The learned query scorer is trained on this channel.
design.address_independence: address keys independent of payload and answer.
design.semantic_scope: opaque associative addressing only; no semantic/content-derived address inference.

protocol.model: learned bilinear query/key metric plus learned candidate-key bias; initialized at the identity metric with zero candidate-bias output; no raw-dot inference path

required_controls: raw-dot Bayes reference on every corruption condition

decision_rule.does_not_license: A learned-address claim from exact-key saturation alone.

decision_rule.condition: On isotropic Gaussian corruption, learned addressing is non-inferior to raw dot within 0.02 absolute accuracy
decision_rule.licenses: Bounded evidence of learned scorer calibration to the registered Bayes reference.
decision_rule.does_not_license: Superiority to the Bayes-optimal raw-dot reference or semantic addressing.

decision_rule.condition: On the registered structured diagonal channel, learned scoring exceeds raw dot by at least 0.03 mean accuracy at M=32 over sigma={0.2,0.4}
decision_rule.licenses: Bounded evidence that the learned scorer exploits the registered structured channel beyond raw-dot ranking in a non-saturated regime.
decision_rule.does_not_license: Bayes optimality, semantic entity resolution, content-derived addressing, multimodal capability, or PLM general capability.

decision_rule.condition: Capacity curves are reported at d=16 for all predefined M={3,8,16,32,64,128,256} and the full registered corruption grids with no post-run M or sigma selection
decision_rule.licenses: A complete registered associative-addressing capacity characterization.
decision_rule.does_not_license: Scale invariance, sublinear addressing, or end-to-end C5 support.

decision_rule.licenses: A bounded negative diagnosis for this addressing protocol.

hypothesis: A learned query/key scorer will match the raw-dot Bayes reference on isotropic Gaussian corruption and can exceed raw dot under the registered structured diagonal channel.

arms.name: learned_scorer
arms.intervention: learned shared query/key scoring model trained on registered channel conditions

arms.name: raw_dot
arms.intervention: argmax raw dot product over stored unit keys

held_constant: address dimension 16 and unit-normalized episode-local random keys
predefined isotropic and structured corruption grids
ten registered seeds and 10,000 evaluation trials per condition
raw-dot reference, oracle target-key control, wrong-key corruption, and order-permutation controls
held-out evaluation keys and payloads with no post-run model selection

amendments.change: The structured-channel criterion is moved from M=3 over sigma={0,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4} to a non-saturated high-noise diagnostic at M=32 over sigma={0.2,0.4}, with required learned-minus-raw-dot mean accuracy >=0.03.
amendments.old_definition: At M=3, learned addressing had to exceed raw dot by >=0.05 mean accuracy over the full structured sigma grid.
amendments.new_definition: At M=32, learned addressing must exceed raw dot by >=0.03 mean accuracy over the predefined high-noise structured subset sigma={0.2,0.4}; the full structured grid remains reported.
amendments.rationale: A preregistration feasibility audit of the fixed generator showed raw-dot structured accuracy at M=3 is already near the 1.0 ceiling across the registered sigma range, so a +0.05 mean improvement is mathematically incompatible with the accuracy ceiling. M=32 and the high-noise subset preserve the same structured channel while providing measurable headroom.
amendments.affected: decision criterion only; no model, data generator, or evaluation grid removal
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No learned-address-002 model measurement has been run under the previous criterion.

amendments.change: The benchmark generator is a dedicated learned-address-002 generator, byte-hashed and pinned in the contract; it replaces reuse of the v1 benchmark source in the measurement implementation.
amendments.old_definition: The learned-address-002 implementation had not yet pinned a dedicated benchmark generator source.
amendments.new_definition: The measurement imports the dedicated learned-address-002 benchmark generator and records its exact SHA-256.
amendments.rationale: Ensure the measured corruption process, key generation, payload independence, and condition grids have independent byte-level provenance rather than inheriting an unrelated v1 runner source.
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No learned-address-002 model measurement has been run.
